projects.name: QueueUp - Ticket management dashboard
projects.description: A responsive SaaS prototype modeling a complete business workflow—from a conversion-focused landing page to a secure, data-driven dashboard with full ticket management capabilities.

choices.title: Robust Data Integrity
choices.description: Implemented Zod schemas for strict form validation, ensuring error-free data submission.

choices.title: UX/UI Design
choices.description: Built a clean, accessible layout with TailwindCSS, featuring toast notifications and status-based filtering.

choices.title: Full-Stack Prototyping
choices.description: Leveraged AI to generate a functional backend with JWT mock authentication, allowing for a focus on production-grade frontend architecture and API consumption.

projects.name: Multilingual Translation Interface
projects.description: A functional language converter supporting English, French, and Spanish with bidirectional swapping logic.

choices.title: Performance Optimization
choices.description: Implemented input debouncing to manage real-time translation requests, significantly reducing API overhead and preventing rate-limiting during rapid typing.

choices.title: Native Browser Integration
choices.description: Leveraged the Web Speech API for text-to-speech synthesis (accessibility) and the Clipboard API for seamless user copying.

choices.title: Asynchronous UX
choices.description: Implemented dedicated loading states to maintain UI responsiveness and provide visual feedback during data fetching/translation processing.
